intro.sr: Kompletan tok zakazivanja: klijent bira uslugu, termin i potvrđuje zakazivanje, a zatim administrator potvrđuje i završava termin.
intro.en: The full booking flow: a customer picks a service and time slot and confirms the booking, then an admin confirms and completes the appointment.

registracija.sr: Klijent se registruje popunjavanjem forme sa imenom, prezimenom, email adresom i lozinkom.
registracija.en: The customer registers by filling in a form with their name, email, and password.

prijava.sr: Nakon registracije, klijent se prijavljuje na svoj novi nalog.
prijava.en: After registering, the customer logs into their new account.

otvaranje-stranice-usluge.sr: Klijent otvara stranicu izabrane usluge, gde vidi opis i dostupne varijante (npr. trajanje i cenu).
otvaranje-stranice-usluge.en: The customer opens the page for the chosen service, where they see the description and available variants (e.g. duration and price).

izbor-varijante-usluge.sr: Klikom na „Izaberi” klijent bira konkretnu varijantu usluge i prelazi na izbor termina.
izbor-varijante-usluge.en: Clicking "Select" chooses the specific service variant and moves on to picking a time slot.

heading.en: Pick a date and time slot

izbor-datuma-i-termina.sr: Klijent bira datum, sistem prikazuje slobodne termine za taj dan na osnovu radnog vremena zaposlenih, a klijent klikne na željeni slot.
izbor-datuma-i-termina.en: The customer picks a date; the system shows the free slots for that day based on employee working hours, and the customer clicks the desired slot.

unos-kontakt-podataka.sr: Klijent unosi broj telefona za kontakt pre nego što potvrdi zakazivanje.
unos-kontakt-podataka.en: The customer enters a contact phone number before confirming the booking.

potvrda-zakazivanja.sr: Klijent potvrđuje zakazivanje. Termin se kreira u statusu „na čekanju”, dok ga administrator ne potvrdi.
potvrda-zakazivanja.en: The customer confirms the booking. The appointment is created with status "pending" until an admin confirms it.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje na svoj nalog kako bi obradio novi termin.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs into their account to process the new appointment.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na dropdown sa svojim imenom u gornjem desnom uglu.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: The admin clicks the dropdown showing their name in the top-right corner.

admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.sr: Administrator bira „Admin panel” iz menija, čime se otvara admin deo sajta.
admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.en: The admin picks "Admin panel" from the menu, opening the site's admin area.

admin-termini-otvara-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na grupu „Zakazivanje” u admin meniju, gde vidi dostupne stavke.
admin-termini-otvara-meni.en: The admin clicks the "Scheduling" group in the admin menu, seeing the available items.

admin-termini-bira-stavku.sr: Administrator bira „Termini” iz menija, čime se otvara lista svih termina.
admin-termini-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Appointments" from the menu, opening the list of all appointments.

admin-termini-pretraga.sr: Administrator pretražuje listu po email adresi klijenta da bi brzo pronašao novi termin.
admin-termini-pretraga.en: The admin searches the list by the customer's email to quickly find the new appointment.

heading.en: Open the appointment from the results

admin-termini-otvaranje-rezultata.sr: Administrator otvara detalje termina klikom na ikonicu u redu tabele.
admin-termini-otvaranje-rezultata.en: The admin opens the appointment's details by clicking the icon in the table row.

admin-potvrdjuje-termin.sr: Administrator potvrđuje termin. Klijent tek sada ima siguran, potvrđen termin u kalendaru.
admin-potvrdjuje-termin.en: The admin confirms the appointment. Only now does the customer have a firm, confirmed slot on the calendar.

admin-zavrsava-termin.sr: Nakon što je usluga zaista pružena, administrator označava termin kao završen. Ovo je i trenutak kada se, ako je uključen partner/zaposleni sa provizijom, ona obračunava.
admin-zavrsava-termin.en: Once the service has actually been delivered, the admin marks the appointment as completed. This is also the point where employee/partner commission, if applicable, gets recorded.
